column1: # Campaign 23 source evidence for the bounded physical BIGINT Selection operator.

column5: The bounded physical owner accepts resolved signed-BIGINT comparison conditions and exact input offsets but does not port logical Selection construction, predicate simplification, property derivation, statistics, cost, or optimizer transformations.

PhysicalSelectionPlan owns nonempty resolved conditions, source operand order, query-block metadata, explain metadata, and the TiKV executor-list no-child layout; TiFlash tree children, cloning, costs, statistics, task attachment, and the full physical operator remain open.

The physical operator exposes typed comparison operands and input offsets to the separate expression serializer; expression codec serialization, schema resolution beyond signed BIGINT, TiFlash conversion, and the remaining expression-codec surface remain open.
